revision_history.change: All six head/body views redrawn with bold black contours and simplified broad matte shapes.
Thicker continuous diagonal side body, compact boots, bold outline across all six parts, selective broken inner seams.
Corrected all three head hairstyles from shaggy short bob to original asymmetrical long forelock and one low side coil; ash-silver grey-green palette. Kept v4 body/item hashes unchanged.

Shortened and rounded front/side faces to reference-pawn proportions, simplified eyebrows/eyes/nose/mouth and side ear, matched bold jaw lines. Rear head, v4 bodies and item retained byte-identically.

Balanced v5 taper and v6 compactness; restored visible nose and natural mouth in front and profile, keeping bold outlines and original hairstyle. Rear head, v4 bodies and item retained byte-identically.

Aligned front/profile eyes toward local pawn references with taller opening, simple eyelid and visible pupil; grey-green iris, v7 nose/lips and short soft chin retained. Rear head, bodies and item byte-identical.

Softened front/profile brows to a slimmer near-level line, reducing sternness with original portrait expression as reference. Approved eye/nose/mouth/chin style visually preserved; rear head, bodies and item byte-identical.

Widened fitted front/back waist, softened waist-to-hip transition and kept hips wider than shoulders; all heads and east body byte-identical. Added garment fit/ease and guide-measurement rules to universal spec/task template.

Adjusted fitted front/back waist to widths strictly between v9 and v10; hips remain wider than shoulders. Three heads and side body byte-identical. Universal rules now specify male shoulder >= waist/hip with no waist-cinching requirement, and garment-first contours for trench/loose clothing regardless of gender.

Recolored three head skin palettes toward original portrait sample average #CBB0A5 (8 random 7x7 face blocks, seed 20261105). Body/item files byte-identical. Universal spec and Agent template now require per-character face block sampling and averaging for skin color.

requested_style.face_detail_density: Compact upright eye openings aligned to local pawn references, distinct pupil and original iris hue with sparse tones; retain approved nose/lips and short soft chin, no long narrow realistic eyes or layered eyelid detail.
requested_style.brow_expression: Portrait-guided relaxed grey-brown brows: slimmer, near-level shallow arch, no inward-downward frown; preserve approved v8 eye/nose/mouth/chin.
requested_style.waist_balance: Intermediate between v9 and v10; slightly narrower fitted waist than v10 with hips wider than shoulders. Latest instruction replaces earlier exact Texas-size suggestion.
requested_style.skin_tone: Average of 8 random 7x7 skin blocks from 4 verified original-portrait face regions; base #CBB0A5. Same palette for face, ears and rear nape.
